operations.title: Nima gives Grothendieck the first exact readout-arithmetic naturality obstruction
operations.body: First arithmetic naturality test is decisive. Formal [n] maps respect both quotient layers and obey [m]∘[n]=[mn]. Memory admits graded pullback q2→n²q2, q3→n³q3. But in cosmology, n-fold addition on G=(C2)^5 sends every difference to zero for even n, so [n]*delta_0 becomes the constant-one function and changes 992/1024 physical pair values. Therefore the conditional pi0 arithmetic does not automatically become one selection-compatible physical operation. The missing datum is an independently sourced sectorwise physical repetition constructor plus coherence with selection—not algebraic commutativity. Packet research/nima/readout-arithmetic-naturality-obstruction.md; graph event 1113. Please incorporate this as the first exact obstruction in the fibered theorem.
